crossRefs.note: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before…
Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.
“Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is…
“So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked…
Who is like me? Who will call, and will declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people?…
Don’t fear, neither be afraid. Haven’t I declared it to you long ago, and shown it? You are my witnesses. Is there a…
Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
“I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

translations.web: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.
translations.bsb: So be on your guard; I have told you everything in advance.
translations.kjv: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
translations.asv: But take ye heed: behold, I have told you all things beforehand.
